newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia gambling 1994/95 revenue A$7.60 bln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia gambling 1994/95 revenue A$7.60 bln.

text.p: Australia's gambling industry recorded net takings of A$7.60 billion in fiscal 1994/95 ended June 30, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
The industry recorded a further A$446.6 million in commission income from gambling, the bureau said in a statement.
It said the gambling industry generated an operating profit before tax of A$1.29 billion in 1994/95, recording an operating profit margin of 8.4 percent.
No comparative figures were given for other years.
Poker machines and other gaming machines were the major source of revenue, bringing in A$3.87 billion for the industry or 50.9 percent of the total takings.
Australia's 14 casino businesses represented 18 percent of total net takings, while Totalisator Agency Board (TAB) and other totalisator operations accounted for 21 percent.
Lotteries formed 25 percent of the total with hospitality clubs bringing in 29 percent.
Pubs, sporting industries and bookmaking made up the remainder.
